top_signals.title: US-Iran Clashes Hit Stocks as Oil Rises | Bloomberg Brief 09/02/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures fall and bond yields remain elevated as renewed US-Iran hostilities push oil higher, leaving the prospect of a September interest rate hike in play. Nigel Blenkinsop, COO of Jaguar Land Rover, joins "Bloomberg Brief" as the carmaker launches the first fully electric Range Rover. Cayla Seder of State Street looks at the concerns in the Treasury market amid rate-hike bets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: There is 'a lot more pushback' on data center construction, Berkshire CEO Greg Abel tells CNBC
top_signals.summary: The resistance to data centers is gaining steam and occurring nationwide.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
